candidates.prompt: Edit the FIRST image, an existing source-bound enhanced battle texture atlas. The SECOND image is its original game artwork controlling topology, fragment layout and broad palette. Original teal/green palette and illumination are immutable; bright inserts stay flat at the original brightness with NO new halo, shine, directional light or bloom. Keep relief edges, counts and silhouettes; never invent masonry joints, cracks, pipes, symbols or objects. Keep the short upper partial cap, single squat mint rectangular central inset and bottom partial black slot/neighbor edges. Do not add ornate framing or increase glow. Treat the first image as a minimally editable layout template. Refine texture within existing forms only. Keep exact outer crop and all tiny atlas scraps. Opaque texture output with black gaps maintained; runtime STP is restored separately from the original.
